name: Blue-Green Deployment on EC2
summary: Implement a blue-green deployment strategy on AWS EC2 to minimize downtime and risks during application updates.
description: This project aims to implement a blue-green deployment strategy on the AWS EC2 platform, which is designed to enhance application availability and reduce downtime during updates. The blue-green deployment method involves maintaining two identical environments, referred to as 'blue' and 'green.' At any given time, one environment is live (serving production traffic) while the other is idle. During updates, the new version of the application is deployed to the idle environment, allowing for thorough testing before switching traffic over. This approach minimizes risks associated with application updates, as it enables quick rollbacks in case of issues. The project will include setting up the necessary AWS infrastructure, configuring load balancers, and implementing deployment scripts to automate the process. By the end of this project, clients will have a robust deployment strategy that ensures seamless application updates with minimal disruption to users.
